title: No indexable page exists for any North County town on launch day, so 'community groups in Encinitas/Carlsbad/Oceanside' searches have nothing to land on.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/discover/cities/[citySlug]/page.tsx:68 sets noindex unless the town has >=3 upcoming events or >=2 Spaces (lib/seo/index-floor.ts:12); app/sitemap.ts:559-566 lists towns only above that floor; page 404s when a town has nothing public (page.tsx:91). generateStaticParams only covers density cities (page.tsx:30).

WHY IT MATTERS: Frequency opens 1 Jan 2027 with near-zero events, so every town page is noindex and out of the sitemap. The whole local-SEO and AI-answer plan for Encinitas, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Vista, San Marcos, Escondido, Solana Beach and Del Mar depends on these pages.

FIX DIRECTION: Add editorial, always-indexable pages for the founding towns (or one /north-county-san-diego hub plus town sections) with real copy, FAQ, breadcrumb schema, and list them in the sitemap regardless of the density floor.

2026-11-16: /north-county-san-diego is an always-indexable hub (FrequencyNorthCounty kit page, one section per FOUNDING_CITIES town, answer-first FAQ with FAQPage, breadcrumb and CollectionPage JSON-LD) listed in the sitemap regardless of the density floor. The per-town /discover/cities pages keep their floor by design.
